The shop

Old chairs. Steady hands.

Step in off Bay Street and the room does the talking: carved bureaus at every station, tufted waiting chairs, barber poles in the window and mirrors in gilt frames. Regulars say the cuts are as dependable as the furniture.

“The old, original chairs and bureaus, the ambience… I’ve been a customer for years, and there’s a really good reason I keep coming back.”

Google review, May 2025
  • Walk in — no app, no booking, just come by.
  • Bring cash — reviewers point to the CIBC ATM just east on Dundas.
  • Seven days — early mornings on weekdays, open Sundays.
